about_the_game:
Deep underground, the advanced city of Umbral lies in silence. Strange silicon lifeforms stir in the depths, dormant robots await the call of their long-slumbering masters, and a lone scientist remains trapped—waiting for help.

Tasked with a mission to determine Umbral’s fate before time runs out, with limited energy, every decision counts. Will you explore, restore, or destroy?

  • Hack city storage to scavenge vital materials.

  • Snipe security drones with your long-range graviton beam.

  • Absorb lost personality cores to upgrade yourself.

As you navigate the city's 45 districts, each linked to its vast neural network, you’ll encounter strange and sentient beings—Dendrone, Cybersaur, the Twins, and the Dross Bishop—each holding fragments of your past.

Even when your BODY resists, something deep inside remembers who you are… until whispers of a THETA Military presence surface. A hidden faction, reawakening with an unfinished mission of its own.

With only five years before Umbral collapses, will you reach the city's core in time—or be buried with its secrets forever?

  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Processor: 1.1+ GHz Processor
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics card with DX10 (shader model 4.0) capabilities
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Cybervoid is a sci-fi story-rich choice-driven adventure. Sent on a mysterious mission, will you follow orders or forge your own path? Manage your time and energy wisely exploring a city on the edge of salvation or ruin and in doing so, ultimately discover your connection to this city and its fate.
